research_question: What is the concept of reincarnation across different religious and philosophical traditions?

indic_traditions.scope: Reincarnation concepts in Hindu, Buddhist, Jain, and Sikh traditions
known_sources: Bhagavad Gita - Krishna's discourse on soul transmigration
Jain theory of Karma and soul migration
indic_traditions.special_instructions: Include detailed analysis of karma, moksha, samsara, and how rebirth differs between Hindu and Buddhist frameworks

western_philosophy.scope: Reincarnation in Western philosophical traditions, Pythagorean and Platonic thought
known_sources: Plato - Phaedo, Republic Myth of Er
western_philosophy.special_instructions: Include analysis of how ancient Greek thought influenced modern Western interpretations

ancient_civilizations.scope: Reincarnation beliefs in ancient Egypt, Mesopotamia, and other early civilizations
known_sources: Egyptian Book of the Dead - soul journey
ancient_civilizations.special_instructions: Distinguish between reincarnation and afterlife concepts in these traditions

contemporary_scholarship.scope: Modern academic study of reincarnation, parapsychology research, comparative religion analysis
known_sources: Ian Stevenson - Twenty Cases Suggestive of Reincarnation
Jim Tucker - Past Life Memories in Children
Dr. Walter Semkiw - Return to Life
Dr. Satwant Pasricha - Claims of Reincarnation in India
contemporary_scholarship.special_instructions: Focus on empirical research, methodological challenges, and controversies in the field
